conditions: TrackMan normalises to sea level, 75 F (23.9 C), 75 % relative humidity (stated for the amateur data; assumed for the tour tables). No wind. Carry, apex and landing angle are on flat ground at launch height.

tm_tour.what: TrackMan PGA Tour and LPGA Tour averages, the widely republished per-club table (2014 vintage; newer TrackMan pages give a 113-115 mph driver).
tm_tour.verified_fields: club speed, ball speed, smash, launch, spin and carry for PGA driver-6 iron and LPGA driver-8 iron were read from a text copy on 2026-10-12. The rest (PGA 7 iron-PW, LPGA 9 iron-PW, every apex and landing angle, attack angles) are the table as remembered and are marked verified: false until checked against TrackMan's own page, which publishes it as an image.

tm_ama.what: TrackMan, 'Performance of the average male amateur' (2014): TrackMan Combine data, over 10,000 golfers, average handicap 14.5. Carry and landing angle normalised.

tm_combine.what: TrackMan Combine averages by handicap: driver club speed (What is Club Speed?) and driver spin (What is Spin Rate?). The two pages disagree on which spin list is male and which female; the male club speeds are unambiguous.

shotscope.what: Shot Scope real-round iron distances by handicap (2026), as reported by GolfLens and MyGolfSpy. Real rounds include mishits and are closer to total than carry: a sniff reference only, never a fit target.

rule_of_thumb.what: Carry per mph of club speed implied by the TrackMan rows above: driver 2.18 (amateur, 93.4 mph) to 2.43 (PGA, 113 mph) yd/mph; 7 iron 1.81 (amateur, 80 mph) to 1.91 (PGA, 90 mph). Used to set sniff bands for speeds the tables don't cover.

sniff_note: Sniff cases are never fitted. Their launch conditions are ASSUMPTIONS (marked per row) standing in for the impact model (M4): smash, launch and spin chosen from the nearest measured row. The band is what a golfer of that level carries, from the sources named. 7-iron smash is 1.33 for every sniff row (2026-10-12). Bands for the three slowest drivers were re-anchored to TrackMan ball-speed data on 2026-10-12 (each row says why); their old club-speed rule-of-thumb bands are kept as rule_of_thumb_band_yd.
